text: Corrected five-point velocity scale and irregular-grid semantics; gaps cannot contribute velocity; peak velocity is retained from classified samples. Added pinned machine-readable oracle, reproducible generator, and cross-platform conformance suite. Evidence: oracle JSON reproduced exactly from pinned upstream; Detect 52/52 and FS2 6/6 pass on JVM and JS; compileAll, aggregate Test/compile, checkBoundaries, scalafmt, and git diff --check pass. The 12*period half-scale mutant failed both conformance tests. TrustRegressionSuite improved from 7 red/11 green to exactly 5 red/13 green on both platforms.
